findings.detail: The filing's non-accrual amortized cost of $27.21 million ties to the Vardiman row with cost 27,212 only; the second Vardiman row with cost 3,759 should not be counted as non-accrual.

rationale: The source schedule reports Non-accrual amortized cost of 27.21 million. In the SOI, Vardiman row 35 has cost 27,212, which ties to that schedule amount, while Vardiman row 36 has additional cost 3,759 and a separate footnote set. Treating both source artifact rows as non-accrual overstates the non-accrual positions from one source-supported position to two.
